about: The GPU, the engine settings every model shares, and the two ways the card is carved (D-40). Models are in deploy/models/.

estimates.note: activation peak = max_num_batched_tokens × 2 B × (4·hidden + 2·intermediate); CUDA context and MFU are assumptions. On the 8B slice this predicted 79,701 KV tokens; vLLM measured 79,056 (−0.8 %).

gate.why: vLLM refuses to start unless one max-length request fits, so below 1 a deploy only wastes a boot; below 2 the worker serves one long audit at a time (tight)

sliced.purpose: N workers on HAMi slices of 20 GiB and half the SMs each: GPU slicing, routing, affinity and the KV hop between workers

full.purpose: one worker with the whole card: the model-quality benchmark, and the larger models that do not fit a slice
